FAQ_DATA.q: How do I register for Technofest 2026?
FAQ_DATA.a: Click any Register Now button on this page. You will be redirected to the official Technofest 2026 Google Form where you can complete your registration.

FAQ_DATA.q: Can I participate in both technical and non-technical events?
FAQ_DATA.a: Yes! Select 'Both' in the Event Participation section of the registration form, then choose your preferred technical and non-technical events.

FAQ_DATA.q: Can I select multiple events within a category?
FAQ_DATA.a: The registration form allows multiple event selections within your chosen category (Technical, Non-Technical or Both). Select all the events you wish to participate in.
Technofest 2026 is on 30 September 2026. Mark your calendar!

FAQ_DATA.q: Where do I submit my registration?
FAQ_DATA.a: Registration is completed entirely through the official Technofest 2026 Google Form. Click any Register Now button to access the form.

FAQ_DATA.q: Where can I find event-specific rules?
FAQ_DATA.a: Click on any event card to view its details. Event-specific rules, eligibility criteria and additional information will be updated here as they become available from the organisers.

FAQ_DATA.q: What information do I need to register?
FAQ_DATA.a: You will need: your college name, your full name, a 10-digit mobile number, your email address, your department, your event participation category, and the names of the events you wish to join.
Details about registration fees will be announced soon. Please check back here or contact the organisers for the latest information.

FAQ_DATA.q: What is the venue for Technofest 2026?
FAQ_DATA.a: The venue for Technofest 2026 will be announced soon. Stay tuned for updates.
